You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 4f22aa4569e55131d69dae87e76869070d62c392 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2021 17:42:02 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] qcom: spm: allow compile-testing

ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE can be selected when compile-testing on
other architectures, but this causes a Kconfig warning
for QCOM_SPM:

WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for QCOM_SPM
  Depends on [n]: ARCH_QCOM [=n]
  Selected by [y]:
  - ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE [=y] && CPU_IDLE [=y] && (ARM [=y] || ARM64) && (ARCH_QCOM [=n] || COMPILE_TEST [=y]) && !ARM64 && MMU [=y]

Make it possible to also compile-test this one, which can
be done now that v5.15-rc5 lets you select QCOM_SCM everywhere.

Fixes: a871be6b8eee ("cpuidle: Convert Qualcomm SPM driver to a generic CPUidle driver")
Fixes: 498ba2a8a275 ("cpuidle: Fix ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE configuration")
Reviewed-by: Stephen Boyd <swboyd@chromium.org>
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>

diff --git a/drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig b/drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig
index 3cf3a6b41182..e718b8735444 100644
--- a/drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig
@@ -192,7 +192,7 @@ config QCOM_SOCINFO
 
 config QCOM_SPM
 	tristate "Qualcomm Subsystem Power Manager (SPM)"
-	depends on ARCH_QCOM
+	depends on ARCH_QCOM || COMPILE_TEST
 	select QCOM_SCM
 	help
 	  Enable the support for the Qualcomm Subsystem Power Manager, used
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig`**
   - The dependency for the `QCOM_SPM` configuration option was modified. 
   - Changed from:
     ```plaintext
     depends on ARCH_QCOM
     ```
     to:
     ```plaintext
     depends on ARCH_QCOM || COMPILE_TEST
     ```

### Relationships

- The modification allows the `QCOM_SPM` configuration to be selected not only when the architecture is Qualcomm (ARCH_QCOM) but also when compile-testing is enabled (COMPILE_TEST). This change addresses a Kconfig warning related to unmet dependencies when `ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE` is selected during compile-testing on non-Qualcomm architectures. The patch is part of a broader effort to enhance the flexibility of the configuration options for the Qualcomm Subsystem Power Manager driver.

1. analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 
2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug.

You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the `QCOM_SPM` configuration option being restricted to only the Qualcomm architecture (ARCH_QCOM), which led to unmet dependency warnings when attempting to compile-test the `ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE` option on other architectures. This restriction prevented users from successfully compiling the driver in a compile-testing environment, even though the underlying code could support it.
        
        Commit message:
        qcom: spm: allow compile-testing

Make it possible to also compile-test this one, which can
